question_mn: Уул уурхайн чиглэлийн хэдэн байгууллага манай харилцагч вэ?
question_latin: Uul uurhain chigleliin heden baiguullaga manai hariltsagch we?
question_en: How many organizations in the mining sector are our customers?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.organizations WHERE industry_sector = 'Уул уурхай'
alt_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.organizations WHERE industry_code IN ('B05', 'B07')

question_mn: Хар жагсаалтад орсон харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: khar jagsaaltad orson khariltsagch khed baina
question_en: How many customers are on the blacklist?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers WHERE is_blacklisted
alt_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers WHERE status_code = 'BLACKLIST'

question_mn: Улс төрд нөлөө бүхий этгээд гэж бүртгэгдсэн хэдэн харилцагч байгаа вэ?
question_latin: Uls turd nuluu bvhii etgeed gej bvrtgegdsen heden hariltsagch baigaa we?
question_en: How many customers are registered as politically exposed persons?
question_mixed: PEP гэж тэмдэглэгдсэн хэдэн клиент байна?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers WHERE is_pep

question_mn: KYC-ийн хугацаа нь дууссан харилцагчийн тоог гаргаж өгнө үү.
question_latin: KYC-iin khugatsaa ni duussan khariltsagchiin toog gargaj ogno uu
question_en: Please give the number of customers whose KYC has expired.
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers WHERE kyc_status = 'EXPIRED'

question_mn: Мөнгө угаалтын шалгалтад тааралт илэрч, одоо шалгагдаж байгаа харилцагч хэд вэ?
question_latin: Mungu ugaaltiin shalgaltad taaralt ilerch, odoo shalgagdaj baigaa hariltsagch hed we?
question_en: How many customers have an AML screening match that is currently under review?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers WHERE aml_status = 'MATCH_PENDING'

question_mn: 2025 онд хэдэн шинэ харилцагч бүртгүүлсэн бэ?
question_latin: 2025 ond heden shine hariltsagch bvrtgvvlsen be
question_en: How many new customers signed up in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers WHERE onboarded_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'

question_mn: Орон нутагт манайх хэдэн салбартай вэ?
question_latin: Oron nutagt manaikh kheden salbartai ve?
question_en: How many branches do we have in rural areas?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.branches WHERE province <> 'Улаанбаатар'

question_mn: Хаагдсан салбар байгаа юу? Байвал нэр, хаагдсан огноог нь гарга.
question_latin: Haagdsan salbar baigaa yu? Baiwal ner, haagdsan ognoog ni garga
question_en: Is there any closed branch? If so, show its name and closing date.
gold_sql: SELECT branch_name, closed_date FROM t2s.branches WHERE closed_date IS NOT NULL
alt_sql: SELECT branch_name, closed_date FROM t2s.branches WHERE NOT is_active

question_mn: Хамгийн сүүлд нээгдсэн салбар аль вэ? Нэр, нээгдсэн огноог нь хэлээрэй.
question_latin: Khamgiin suuld neegdsen salbar ali ve? ner, neegdsen ognoog ni kheleerei
question_en: Which branch was opened most recently? Tell me its name and opening date.
gold_sql: SELECT branch_name, opened_date FROM t2s.branches ORDER BY opened_date DESC, branch_id LIMIT 1

question_mn: Одоо чөлөөтэй байгаа ажилтнуудын нэр, албан тушаалыг жагсаа.
question_latin: Odoo chuluutei baigaa ajiltnuudiin ner, alban tushaaliig jagsaa
question_en: List the names and positions of the employees who are currently on leave.
gold_sql: SELECT full_name, position_name FROM t2s.employees WHERE employment_status = 'ON_LEAVE'

question_mn: Ховд аймагт амьдардаг харилцагч хэд вэ?
question_latin: Howd aimagt amidardag hariltsagch hed we?
question_en: How many customers live in Khovd province?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers WHERE province = 'Ховд'
notes: Хаягийн аймгаар (Ховд салбарын харилцагч 107 — өөр)

question_mn: Оюу Толгойд ажилладаг хэдэн харилцагч байна?
question_latin: Oyu Tolgoid ajilladag heden hariltsagch bn?
question_en: How many of our customers work at Oyu Tolgoi?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.individuals WHERE employer_name = 'Оюу Толгой ХХК'
alt_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.individuals WHERE employer_name LIKE 'Оюу Толгой%'
notes: Асуултад 'ХХК'-гүй, дагавартай бичигдсэн утга

question_mn: Гэрлэлтийн байдал нь бөглөгдөөгүй хувь хүн харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: Gerleltiin baidal ni buglugduugvi huwi hvn hariltsagch hed baina?
question_en: How many individual customers have no marital status filled in?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.individuals WHERE marital_status IS NULL

question_mn: Энэ онд хэдэн хүн ажилд орсон бэ?
question_latin: Ene ond kheden khun ajild orson be?
question_en: How many people have been hired this year?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.employees WHERE hire_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND CURRENT_DATE

question_mn: Баянзүрх дүүрэгт амьдардаг харилцагчдыг сегментээр нь тоолж гарга.
question_latin: Bayanzvrh dvvregt amidardag hariltsagchdiig segmenteer ni toolj garga
question_en: Count the customers who live in Bayanzurkh district by segment.
gold_sql: SELECT segment_name, count(*) AS customer_count FROM t2s.customers WHERE district = 'Баянзүрх' GROUP BY segment_name
alt_sql: SELECT segment_name, count(*) AS customer_count FROM t2s.customers WHERE province = 'Улаанбаатар' AND district = 'Баянзүрх' GROUP BY segment_name
notes: Хаягийн дүүргээр (Баянзүрх салбар биш)

question_mn: Төлөв нь идэвхтэй харилцагчдыг салбараар нь тоолоод, салбарын нэртэй нь гарга.
question_latin: Tolov ni idevkhtei khariltsagchdiig salbaraar ni toolood, salbariin nertei ni garga
question_en: Count the customers whose status is active by branch and show them with the branch names.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, count(*) AS active_customers FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id WHERE c.status_code = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: 2026 онд сар бүр хэдэн шинэ харилцагч нэмэгдсэн бэ? Сарын дугаар, тоог гарга.
question_latin: 2026 ond sar bvr heden shine hariltsagch nemegdsen be? Sariin dugaar, toog garga
question_en: How many new customers were added in each month of 2026? Show the month number and the count.
question_mixed: 2026 онд сар бүрийн new customer-ийн тоог month number-тэй нь гарга
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM onboarded_date) AS month_no, count(*) AS new_customers FROM t2s.customers WHERE onboarded_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Хувь хүн харилцагчдыг 10 насаар бүлэглээд (бүлгийг доод насаар нь: 20, 30, 40 гэх мэт), бүлэг бүрт хэдэн хүн байгааг гарга.
question_latin: Huwi hvn hariltsagchdiig 10 nasaar bvlegleed (bvlgiig dood nasaar ni: 20, 30, 40 geh met), bvleg bvrt heden hvn baigaag garga
question_en: Group individual customers into 10-year age bands (labelled by the lower age: 20, 30, 40, etc.) and show how many people are in each band.
gold_sql: SELECT (age / 10) * 10 AS age_band, count(*) AS customer_count FROM t2s.individuals GROUP BY 1
alt_sql: SELECT floor(age / 10.0) * 10 AS age_band, count(*) AS customer_count FROM t2s.individuals GROUP BY 1
notes: 19 настай харилцагчид 10-ын бүлэгт орно

question_mn: Сегмент бүрийн хувь хүн харилцагчдын дундаж сарын орлого хэд вэ?
question_latin: Segment bvriin huwi hvn hariltsagchdiin dundaj sariin orlogo hed we?
question_en: What is the average monthly income of individual customers in each segment?
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment_name, ROUND(AVG(i.monthly_income), 2) AS avg_income FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.individuals i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment_name

question_mn: Хувь хүн харилцагчийн төрөл бүрийн сарын орлогын медианыг тооцоолж өгөөч.
question_latin: Khuvi khun khariltsagchiin torol buriin sariin orlogiin medianiig tootsoolj ogooch
question_en: Calculate the median monthly income for each individual customer type.
question_mixed: Хувь хүний customer type бүрээр monthly income-ийн median-ийг тооцоол
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_type_name, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY i.monthly_income) AS median_income FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.individuals i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_type_name

question_mn: Хувь хүн харилцагчдын хэдэн хувь нь эмэгтэй вэ?
question_latin: Huwi hvn hariltsagchdiin heden huwi ni emegtei we?
question_en: What percentage of individual customers are female?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE gender = 'FEMALE') / count(*), 2) AS female_pct FROM t2s.individuals

question_mn: Байгууллага харилцагч 20-оос олон байгаа үйл ажиллагааны чиглэлүүдийг байгууллагын тоо, нийт жилийн борлуулалттай нь гарга.
question_latin: Baiguullaga khariltsagch 20-oos olon baigaa uil ajillagaanii chigleluudiig baiguullagiin too, niit jiliin borluulalttai ni garga
question_en: Show the industry sectors that have more than 20 organization customers, with the number of organizations and their total annual revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT industry_sector, count(*) AS org_count, SUM(annual_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM t2s.organizations GROUP BY industry_sector HAVING count(*) > 20
notes: Яг 20 байгууллагатай чиглэл байхгүй (хил давхцахгүй)

question_mn: Эрдэнэт салбарт одоо ажиллаж байгаа ажилтнуудыг албан тушаалаар нь тоолж гарга.
question_latin: Erdenet salbart odoo ajillaj baigaa ajiltnuudiig alban tushaalaar ni toolj garga
question_en: Count the employees currently working at the Erdenet branch by position.
gold_sql: SELECT e.position_name, count(*) AS employee_count FROM t2s.employees e JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = e.branch_id WHERE b.branch_name = 'Эрдэнэт салбар' AND e.employment_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY e.position_name
notes: Ажиллаж байгаа = employment_status ACTIVE (enum-ийн нэр); Эрдэнэтэд чөлөөтэй ажилтан байхгүй

question_mn: Хамгийн олон харилцагч хариуцдаг 5 зээлийн мэргэжилтнийг нэр, харилцагчийн тоотой нь гарга.
question_latin: Khamgiin olon khariltsagch khariutsdag 5 zeeliin mergejiltniig ner, khariltsagchiin tootoi ni garga
question_en: Show the 5 credit officers who are responsible for the most customers, with their names and customer counts.
question_mixed: Хамгийн олон customer-тэй top 5 RM-ийг нэр, харилцагчийн тоотой нь гарга
gold_sql: SELECT e.full_name, count(*) AS customer_count FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = c.relationship_manager_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.full_name ORDER BY customer_count DESC, e.employee_id LIMIT 5

question_mn: Манайхаас нэг ч удаа зээл олгогдож байгаагүй харилцагчдыг хувь хүн, байгууллага гэж ангилаад тус бүрийн тоог гарга.
question_latin: Manaihaas neg ch udaa zeel olgogdoj baigaagvi hariltsagchdiig huwi hvn, baiguullaga gej angilaad tus bvriin toog garga
question_en: Split the customers who have never had a loan disbursed by us into individuals and organizations and show the count of each.
gold_sql: SELECT c.party_type, count(*) AS customer_count FROM t2s.customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.customer_id = c.customer_id AND l.disbursement_date IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY c.party_type
alt_sql: SELECT c.party_type, count(*) AS customer_count FROM t2s.customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.customer_id = c.customer_id AND l.status_code <> 'PENDING_DISBURSEMENT') GROUP BY c.party_type
notes: Олголт хүлээж буй (PENDING_DISBURSEMENT, disbursement_date NULL) зээлтэй 11 харилцагч олгогдоогүйд тооцогдоно

question_mn: KYC-ийн хугацаа нь дууссан эсвэл татгалзсан харилцагч хамгийн олонтой 3 салбарыг тоотой нь гарга.
question_latin: KYC-iin hugatsaa ni duussan eswel tatgalzsan hariltsagch hamgiin olontoi 3 salbariig tootoi ni garga
question_en: Show the 3 branches with the most customers whose KYC is expired or rejected, with the counts.
question_mixed: KYC expired эсвэл rejected болсон харилцагч хамгийн олон байгаа top 3 салбарыг тоотой нь гарга
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, count(*) AS kyc_issue_count FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id WHERE c.kyc_status IN ('EXPIRED', 'REJECTED') GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.branch_name ORDER BY kyc_issue_count DESC, b.branch_id LIMIT 3

question_mn: Резидент бус харилцагчид аль улсаас хэд байгааг гарга.
question_latin: Rezident bus khariltsagchid ali ulsaas khed baigaag garga
question_en: Show how many non-resident customers there are from each country.
gold_sql: SELECT country_code, count(*) AS customer_count FROM t2s.customers WHERE NOT is_resident GROUP BY country_code

question_mn: Орон нутгийн салбар бүр хэдэн харилцагчтай вэ?
question_latin: Oron nutgiin salbar bvr heden hariltsagchtai we?
question_en: How many customers does each rural branch have?
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, count(*) AS customer_count FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id WHERE b.province <> 'Улаанбаатар' GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: Багш мэргэжилтэй харилцагчдын дундаж сарын орлогыг боловсролын түвшнээр нь гарга. Боловсрол нь бүртгэгдээгүйг оруулахгүй.
question_latin: Bagsh mergejiltei khariltsagchdiin dundaj sariin orlogiig bolovsroliin tuvshneer ni garga. Bolovsrol ni burtgegdeeguig oruulakhgui
question_en: Show the average monthly income of customers whose occupation is teacher, by education level, excluding those whose education is not recorded.
gold_sql: SELECT education_level, ROUND(AVG(monthly_income), 2) AS avg_income FROM t2s.individuals WHERE occupation = 'Багш' AND education_level IS NOT NULL GROUP BY education_level

question_mn: Идэвхтэй багцад зээлтэй, мөн идэвхтэй хадгаламжтай харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: Idewhtei bagtsad zeeltei, mun idewhtei hadgalamjtai hariltsagch hed baina?
question_en: How many customers have a loan in the active portfolio and also an active deposit?
question_mixed: Active portfolio-д зээлтэй, бас active депозиттэй харилцагч хэд вэ?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.customer_id = c.customer_id AND l.is_active_portfolio) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.deposits d WHERE d.customer_id = c.customer_id AND d.status = 'ACTIVE')
alt_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT l.customer_id) FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.deposits d ON d.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio AND d.status = 'ACTIVE'

question_mn: Хариуцсан мэргэжилтэн нь ажлаас гарсан харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: Khariutssan mergejilten ni ajlaas garsan khariltsagch khed baina?
question_en: How many customers have a responsible officer who has left the company?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = c.relationship_manager_id WHERE e.employment_status = 'TERMINATED'
alt_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = c.relationship_manager_id WHERE e.termination_date IS NOT NULL
notes: Өгөгдлийн онцлог: ажлаас гарсан 7 мэргэжилтэнд 262 харилцагч бүртгэлтэй хэвээр

question_mn: Ажлаас гараагүй, 5-аас дээш жил ажилласан ажилтан хэд байна?
question_latin: Ajlaas garaagvi, 5-aas deesh jil ajillasan ajiltan hed bn?
question_en: How many employees who have not left the company have worked here for more than 5 years?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.employees WHERE termination_date IS NULL AND hire_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 years'
alt_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.employees WHERE employment_status <> 'TERMINATED' AND hire_date < DATE '2021-06-30'
notes: 2021-06-30-нд ажилд орсон хүн байхгүй тул < ба <= ижил

question_mn: ЖДҮ харилцагчдыг хуулийн этгээдийн хэлбэрээр нь ангилж, тоо болон дундаж ажилтны тоог гаргана уу.
question_latin: JDU khariltsagchdiig khuuliin etgeediin khelbereer ni angilj, too bolon dundaj ajiltnii toog gargana uu
question_en: Please break down SME customers by legal form and show the number of SMEs and their average number of employees.
gold_sql: SELECT o.legal_form, count(*) AS sme_count, ROUND(AVG(o.employee_count), 2) AS avg_employees FROM t2s.organizations o JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_type_code = 'ORG_SME' GROUP BY o.legal_form
notes: ЖДҮ = customer_type_code ORG_SME (glossary). segment_code = 'SME'-ээр шүүвэл ТББ (NGO, 29) мөр нэмэгдэж буруу болно

question_mn: 2026 оны эхний улиралд Дархан салбараас хэдэн шинэ харилцагч бүртгүүлсэн бэ?
question_latin: 2026 onii ehnii ulirald Darhan salbaraas heden shine hariltsagch bvrtgvvlsen be?
question_en: How many new customers registered at the Darkhan branch in the first quarter of 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id WHERE b.branch_name = 'Дархан салбар' AND c.onboarded_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31'

question_mn: Салбар бүрийн KYC баталгаажсан харилцагчийн хувь
question_latin: Salbar buriin KYC batalgaajsan khariltsagchiin khuvi
question_en: Share of customers with verified KYC, by branch.
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, ROUND(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.kyc_status = 'VERIFIED') / count(*), 2) AS verified_pct FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: Дундаж сарын орлогоороо хамгийн өндөр 5 мэргэжлийг дундаж орлоготой нь гарга.
question_latin: Dundaj sariin orlogooroo hamgiin undur 5 mergejliig dundaj orlogotoi ni garga
question_en: Show the 5 occupations with the highest average monthly income, together with the average income.
gold_sql: SELECT occupation, ROUND(AVG(monthly_income), 2) AS avg_income FROM t2s.individuals GROUP BY occupation ORDER BY avg_income DESC LIMIT 5
notes: Дундаж орлогын утгууд давхцахгүй (tie байхгүй)

question_mn: PEP харилцагчдыг сегментээр нь тоолж гарга
question_latin: PEP khariltsagchdiig segmenteer n toolj garga
question_en: Count the PEP (politically exposed) customers by segment.
gold_sql: SELECT segment_name, count(*) AS pep_count FROM t2s.customers WHERE is_pep GROUP BY segment_name

question_mn: Салбарын менежер бүр ажлаас гараагүй хэдэн ажилтныг шууд удирдаж байна? Менежерийн нэр, салбар, ажилтны тоог гарга.
question_latin: Salbariin menejer bvr ajlaas garaagvi heden ajiltniig shuud udirdaj baina? Menejeriin ner, salbar, ajiltnii toog garga
question_en: How many employees who have not left does each branch manager directly supervise? Show the manager's name, the branch and the number of employees.
gold_sql: SELECT m.full_name, b.branch_name, count(*) AS team_size FROM t2s.employees m JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = m.branch_id JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.manager_id = m.employee_id WHERE m.position_code = 'BRANCH_MANAGER' AND e.employment_status <> 'TERMINATED' GROUP BY m.employee_id, m.full_name, b.branch_name

question_mn: Салбар бүрээр 2024, 2025 онд бүртгүүлсэн шинэ харилцагчийн тоо болон өсөлтийн хувийг гарга.
question_latin: Salbar bvreer 2024, 2025 ond bvrtgvvlsen shine hariltsagchiin too bolon usultiin huwiig garga
question_en: For each branch, show the number of new customers registered in 2024 and in 2025 and the growth percentage.
question_mixed: Branch бүрээр 2024, 2025 оны new customer-ийн тоо, YoY growth %-ийг гарга
gold_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT b.branch_name, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.onboarded_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31') AS new_2024, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.onboarded_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31') AS new_2025 FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id GROUP BY b.branch_name) SELECT branch_name, new_2024, new_2025, ROUND(100.0 * (new_2025 - new_2024) / NULLIF(new_2024, 0), 2) AS growth_pct FROM t
notes: Хоёр үеийн харьцуулалт; бүх салбарт 2024 онд шинэ харилцагч бий (0-д хуваахгүй)

question_mn: 2020-2025 онуудын жил бүрийн эцсийн байдлаар манайд хэдэн ажилтан ажиллаж байсныг гарга.
question_latin: 2020-2025 onuudiin jil bvriin etssiin baidlaar manaid heden ajiltan ajillaj baisniig garga
question_en: For each year from 2020 to 2025, show how many employees we had at the end of the year.
gold_sql: WITH h AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM hire_date) AS yr, count(*) AS hired FROM t2s.employees GROUP BY 1), t AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM termination_date) AS yr, count(*) AS left_cnt FROM t2s.employees WHERE termination_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1), c AS (SELECT h.yr, SUM(h.hired - COALESCE(t.left_cnt, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY h.yr) AS headcount FROM h LEFT JOIN t ON t.yr = h.yr) SELECT yr AS year, headcount FROM c WHERE yr BETWEEN 2020 AND 2025
alt_sql: SELECT v.y AS year, (SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.employees e WHERE e.hire_date <= make_date(v.y, 12, 31) AND (e.termination_date IS NULL OR e.termination_date > make_date(v.y, 12, 31))) AS headcount FROM (VALUES (2020), (2021), (2022), (2023), (2024), (2025)) AS v(y)
notes: Жилийн эцэст ажилд орсон, ажлаас гараагүй (чөлөөтэй орно) ажилтан; хуримтлагдсан нийлбэрээр

question_mn: Зээлийн мэргэжилтэн ажиллаж байгаа салбар бүрээр нэг мэргэжилтэнд ногдох идэвхтэй төлөвтэй харилцагчийн тоог гарга.
question_latin: Zeeliin mergejilten ajillaj baigaa salbar bvreer neg mergejiltend nogdoh idewhtei tuluwtei hariltsagchiin toog garga
question_en: For each branch that has working credit officers, show the number of active-status customers per credit officer.
gold_sql: WITH cu AS (SELECT branch_id, count(*) AS n_cust FROM t2s.customers WHERE status_code = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY branch_id), co AS (SELECT branch_id, count(*) AS n_off FROM t2s.employees WHERE position_code = 'CREDIT_OFFICER' AND employment_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY branch_id) SELECT b.branch_name, ROUND(cu.n_cust::numeric / co.n_off, 2) AS customers_per_officer FROM co JOIN cu ON cu.branch_id = co.branch_id JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = co.branch_id
notes: Харилцагчийг харьяалах салбараар, мэргэжилтнийг ажилладаг салбараар; Баянгол-2-т ажиллаж буй мэргэжилтэн байхгүй

question_mn: Үйл ажиллагааны чиглэл бүрт жилийн борлуулалтаараа тэргүүлж буй байгууллагыг олж, чиглэл, байгууллагын нэр, борлуулалтыг гарга.
question_latin: Uil ajillagaanii chiglel burt jiliin borluulaltaaraa terguulj bui baiguullagiig olj, chiglel, baiguullagiin ner, borluulaltiig garga
question_en: For each industry sector, find the organization with the highest annual revenue and show the sector, organization name and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT industry_sector, org_name, annual_revenue FROM (SELECT industry_sector, org_name, annual_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY industry_sector ORDER BY annual_revenue DESC, customer_id) AS rn FROM t2s.organizations) t WHERE rn = 1
alt_sql: SELECT o.industry_sector, o.org_name, o.annual_revenue FROM t2s.organizations o WHERE o.annual_revenue = (SELECT max(x.annual_revenue) FROM t2s.organizations x WHERE x.industry_sector = o.industry_sector)
notes: Чиглэл бүрийн 1-р байранд tie байхгүй

question_mn: Сегмент бүрээр идэвхтэй багцад зээлтэй бөгөөд идэвхтэй хадгаламжтай харилцагчийн тоо, тухайн сегментийн нийт харилцагчид эзлэх хувийг гарга.
question_latin: Segment bvreer idewhtei bagtsad zeeltei buguud idewhtei hadgalamjtai hariltsagchiin too, tuhain segmentiin niit hariltsagchid ezleh huwiig garga
question_en: By segment, show the number of customers who have a loan in the active portfolio and an active deposit, and their share of all customers in that segment.
gold_sql: WITH f AS (SELECT c.segment_name, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.customer_id = c.customer_id AND l.is_active_portfolio) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.deposits d WHERE d.customer_id = c.customer_id AND d.status = 'ACTIVE') AS has_both FROM t2s.customers c) SELECT segment_name, count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_both) AS both_count, ROUND(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_both) / count(*), 2) AS both_pct FROM f GROUP BY segment_name

question_mn: 2026 онд шинэ харилцагчийн тоо өмнөх сараасаа өссөн саруудыг сарын дугаар, тухайн сарын тоо, өмнөх сарын тоотой нь гарга.
question_latin: 2026 ond shine khariltsagchiin too omnokh saraasaa osson saruudiig sariin dugaar, tukhain sariin too, omnokh sariin tootoi ni garga
question_en: In 2026, list the months in which the number of new customers grew compared with the previous month, showing the month number, that month's count and the previous month's count.
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', onboarded_date)::date AS month, count(*) AS n FROM t2s.customers WHERE onboarded_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1), l AS (SELECT month, n, LAG(n) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_n FROM m) SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM month) AS month_no, n AS new_customers, prev_n AS prev_month_customers FROM l WHERE month >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND n > prev_n
notes: 1-р сарыг 2025-12-тай харьцуулна (75 = 75, өсөөгүй) — 2026 дотор LAG хийсэн ч үр дүн ижил

question_mn: 2021 оноос хойш он бүрээр ажилд орсон болон ажлаас гарсан ажилтны тоог зэрэгцүүлэн гарга.
question_latin: 2021 onoos hoish on bvreer ajild orson bolon ajlaas garsan ajiltnii toog zeregtsvvlen garga
question_en: Since 2021, show by year the number of employees hired and the number who left, side by side.
gold_sql: WITH h AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM hire_date) AS yr, count(*) AS hired FROM t2s.employees WHERE hire_date >= DATE '2021-01-01' GROUP BY 1), t AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM termination_date) AS yr, count(*) AS terminated FROM t2s.employees WHERE termination_date >= DATE '2021-01-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(h.yr, t.yr) AS year, COALESCE(h.hired, 0) AS hired, COALESCE(t.terminated, 0) AS terminated FROM h FULL JOIN t ON t.yr = h.yr
notes: 2022 онд ажлаас гарсан хүн байхгүй — 0 гарна

question_mn: Өндөр болон маш өндөр эрсдэлтэй харилцагчийн эзлэх хувь нь бүх харилцагчаар тооцсон хувиас өндөр байгаа салбаруудыг хувьтай нь гарга.
question_latin: Ondor bolon mash ondor ersdeltei khariltsagchiin ezlekh khuvi ni bukh khariltsagchaar tootsson khuvias ondor baigaa salbaruudiig khuvitai ni garga
question_en: Show the branches where the share of high and critical risk customers is higher than that share across all customers, together with the percentage.
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT b.branch_name, 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.risk_level IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL')) / count(*) AS pct FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id GROUP BY b.branch_name) SELECT branch_name, ROUND(pct, 2) AS high_risk_pct FROM s WHERE pct > (SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE risk_level IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL')) / count(*) FROM t2s.customers)
notes: Бүх харилцагчаар 8.27%; салбаруудын хувийн энгийн дундаж (7.34%)-аар бол Мөрөн нэмэгдэнэ — асуулт 'бүх харилцагчаар' гэж тодорхой

question_mn: Салбар бүрт ажиллаж байгаа зээлийн мэргэжилтнүүдээс хамгийн олон харилцагч хариуцдаг нь хэн бэ? Салбар, мэргэжилтний нэр, харилцагчийн тоог гарга.
question_latin: Salbar bvrt ajillaj baigaa zeeliin mergejiltnvvdees hamgiin olon hariltsagch hariutsdag ni hen be? Salbar, mergejiltnii ner, hariltsagchiin toog garga
question_en: In each branch, which working credit officer is responsible for the most customers? Show the branch, the officer's name and the number of customers.
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT b.branch_name, e.full_name, count(*) AS customer_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.branch_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC) AS rk FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = c.relationship_manager_id JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = e.branch_id WHERE e.employment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND e.position_code = 'CREDIT_OFFICER' GROUP BY b.branch_name, e.branch_id, e.employee_id, e.full_name) SELECT branch_name, full_name, customer_count FROM r WHERE rk = 1
notes: Мэргэжилтний ажилладаг салбараар; салбар бүрийн 1-р байранд tie байхгүй

question_mn: Идэвхтэй харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: Idewhtei hariltsagch hed bn
question_en: How many active customers are there?
clarification_mn: Төлөв нь 'Идэвхтэй' гэж бүртгэгдсэн харилцагчийг тоолох уу, эсвэл одоо идэвхтэй багцад зээлтэй харилцагчийг тоолох уу?

interpretations.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers WHERE status_code = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio

question_mn: Гадаад харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: Gadaad khariltsagch khed baina?
question_en: How many foreign customers are there?
clarification_mn: Улсын код нь Монголоос өөр харилцагчийг хэлж байна уу, эсвэл резидент бус харилцагчийг хэлж байна уу?

interpretations.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers WHERE country_code <> 'MN'
SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers WHERE NOT is_resident

notes: 16 гадаад улсын харилцагч резидент байна

question_mn: Хамгийн том байгууллага харилцагч аль вэ?
question_latin: Hamgiin tom baiguullaga hariltsagch ali we?
question_en: Which is our largest organization customer?
clarification_mn: Хэмжээг ажилчдын тоогоор нь, жилийн борлуулалтаар нь, эсвэл манайд байгаа зээлийн үлдэгдлээр нь тодорхойлох уу?

interpretations.sql: SELECT org_name, employee_count FROM t2s.organizations ORDER BY employee_count DESC, customer_id LIMIT 1
SELECT org_name, annual_revenue FROM t2s.organizations ORDER BY annual_revenue DESC, customer_id LIMIT 1

interpretations.label_mn: Идэвхтэй багц дахь зээлийн үндсэн үлдэгдлээр
interpretations.sql: SELECT o.org_name, SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS loan_outstanding FROM t2s.organizations o JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.org_name ORDER BY loan_outstanding DESC, o.customer_id LIMIT 1

question_mn: Сүүлийн 3 сард хэдэн шинэ харилцагч бүртгүүлсэн бэ?
question_latin: Svvliin 3 sard heden shine hariltsagch bvrtgvvlsen be?
question_en: How many new customers registered in the last 3 months?
clarification_mn: Сүүлийн 90 хоногийг хэлж байна уу, эсвэл 4, 5, 6-р сарыг бүтнээр нь хэлж байна уу?

interpretations.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers WHERE onboarded_date > CURRENT_DATE - 90
SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers WHERE onboarded_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'

question_mn: Манайд хэдэн ажилтан байна?
question_latin: Manaid kheden ajiltan baina?
question_en: How many employees do we have?
clarification_mn: Ажлаас гараагүй бүх ажилтныг (чөлөөтэй байгааг оруулаад) тоолох уу, зөвхөн 'Ажиллаж байгаа' төлөвтэйг тоолох уу, эсвэл ажлаас гарсныг оруулаад бүх бүртгэлийг тоолох уу?

interpretations.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.employees WHERE employment_status <> 'TERMINATED'
SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.employees WHERE employment_status = 'ACTIVE'

question_mn: Хан-Уулын харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: Han-Uuliin hariltsagch hed baina?
question_en: How many Khan-Uul customers are there?
clarification_mn: Хан-Уул салбарт харьяалагддаг харилцагчийг хэлж байна уу, эсвэл Хан-Уул дүүрэгт амьдардаг харилцагчийг хэлж байна уу?

interpretations.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers c JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = c.branch_id WHERE b.branch_name = 'Хан-Уул салбар'
SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers WHERE province = 'Улаанбаатар' AND district = 'Хан-Уул'

notes: Утгын хоёрдмол байдал: салбар уу, хаягийн дүүрэг үү

question_mn: Зээлгүй харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: Zeelgui khariltsagch khed baina?
question_en: How many customers have no loan?
clarification_mn: Манайхаас хэзээ ч зээл олгогдож байгаагүй харилцагчийг хэлж байна уу, эсвэл одоогоор идэвхтэй зээлгүй (өмнө нь зээл авч байсан ч) харилцагчийг хэлж байна уу?

interpretations.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.customer_id = c.customer_id AND l.disbursement_date IS NOT NULL)
SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.customer_id = c.customer_id AND l.is_active_portfolio)

question_mn: Тэтгэврийн насны харилцагч хэд байна?
question_latin: Tetgewriin nasnii hariltsagch hed baina?
question_en: How many customers are of retirement age?
clarification_mn: Харилцагчийн төрлөөр 'Тэтгэвэр авагч' гэж ангилагдсаныг тоолох уу, эсвэл насаар нь (жишээ нь 60 ба түүнээс дээш) тоолох уу?

interpretations.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.customers WHERE customer_type_code = 'IND_PENSION'
SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.individuals WHERE age >= 60
